crossRefs.note: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
Abstain from every form of evil.

translations.web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
translations.bsb: Do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
translations.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
translations.asv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
